name: Secondary Interstitial Lung Disease in Childhood and Adulthood Associated with a Metabolic Disease
aliases: Metabolic Disease-Associated Secondary Interstitial Lung Disease
Secondary ILD due to Metabolic Disorders

criteria.description: Confirmed diagnosis of an underlying metabolic disorder known to cause secondary interstitial lung disease
High-resolution CT showing interstitial lung disease patterns consistent with metabolic disease involvement
Restrictive ventilatory defect and reduced diffusing capacity on pulmonary function testing
Lung biopsy demonstrating interstitial fibrosis or storage material consistent with metabolic disease
Exclusion of primary idiopathic interstitial lung diseases and other secondary causes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Confirmed metabolic disease plus radiologic evidence of ILD and pulmonary function abnormalities
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often requires multidisciplinary evaluation including metabolic, pulmonology, and radiology expertise.

searchTerms: worsening shortness of breath with activity

common.symptomName: Growth retardation or failure to thrive (in childhood onset)

occasional.symptomName: Chest discomfort or pleuritic chest pain
Peripheral edema secondary to pulmonary hypertension
searchTerms: swelling from lung high blood pressure
peripheral edema due to pulmonary hypertension
leg swelling related to lung pressure

occasional.symptomName: Mild hepatopathy or liver enzyme elevation

searchTerms: chronic fatigue due to poor oxygenation
feeling weak from long-term low oxygen

rare.symptomName: Pulmonary hypertension with right heart failure
searchTerms: high lung blood pressure with heart failure
right heart failure from pulmonary hypertension

rare.symptomName: Neurological manifestations related to metabolic disease
searchTerms: nerve and brain symptoms from metabolism

laboratory: Elevated serum biomarkers related to metabolic disease (e.g., lysosomal enzymes, substrate accumulation markers)
Hypoxemia on arterial blood gas analysis
imaging: High-resolution CT showing ground-glass opacities, reticulation, and interstitial fibrosis
Enlarged pulmonary arteries in pulmonary hypertension
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes causing metabolic disorders (e.g., lysosomal storage diseases, glycogen storage diseases)
other: Pulmonary function tests showing restrictive pattern with reduced DLCO
Lung biopsy showing interstitial fibrosis and/or storage material deposits

distinguishingFeatures: Typical usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) pattern on imaging
Systemic symptoms such as arthritis, rash

redFlags: Severe hypoxemia refractory to oxygen therapy
